summary_1line: Rama threatens the ocean, forces its god to appear, then Nala builds a massive bridge enabling the monkey army to cross to Lanka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama draws a blazing arrow that shakes heaven and earth while the ocean surges violently under darkened skies.
The ocean god Sagara rises from the waves adorned with pearls and gold, flanked by the rivers Ganga and Sindhu, bowing before Rama.
Thousands of monkeys hurl mountains, trees, and boulders into the sea as Nala directs the construction of the vast bridge to Lanka.
